paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Ablation studies between Consistency-Bi and Consistency-Uni on test set of IWSLT14 De-En task of wait-k policy.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the BLEU score against the average lagging (AL) for various consistency methods. The x-axis, labeled ‘Average Lagging (AL)’, employs a linear scale with values ranging from 2 to 8, marked by tick intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled ‘BLEU’, also utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 24 to 32, marked by tick intervals of 2. A solid red line, marked with a star marker, begins at a BLEU score of approximately 27.5 and decreases linearly to a value of approximately 26.0. A dashed purple line, marked with a circle marker, starts at a BLEU score of approximately 26.0 and increases linearly to a value of roughly 30.0. Finally, a solid green line, marked with a square marker, begins at a BLEU score of approximately 26.0 and increases linearly to a value of approximately 29.5.
